activation_required.description: Requires an authenticated account before opening the translator.

auth_google_enabled.description: Shows Google activation after the provider and OAuth clients are configured.

auth_apple_enabled.description: Shows Apple activation on iOS after the Apple capability and provider are configured.

monetization_enabled.description: Shows paid plans after store products and receipt validation are production ready.

quota_enforcement_enabled.description: Enforces the monthly free allowance. Keep disabled until server-side usage accounting is ready.

free_trial_days.description: Full-access introductory period for a newly activated account.

free_monthly_minutes.description: Monthly active translation allowance after the introductory period.

free_all_signs.description: Keeps the entire installed LSC vocabulary available to free accounts.

continuous_mode_enabled.description: Makes continuous live translation available on Android and iOS.

continuous_mode_requires_plus.description: Requires a verified Plus entitlement for continuous live translation.

picture_in_picture_enabled.description: Makes Picture-in-Picture available on Android and iOS.

pip_requires_plus.description: Requires a verified Plus entitlement for Picture-in-Picture.

phrase_mode_requires_plus.description: Keeps phrase translation free during the launch period.

free_usage_measurement.description: Defines usage as speech processing plus avatar playback, excluding silence.

usage_warning_minutes.description: Remaining-minute thresholds shown before the free allowance runs out.

google_web_client_id.description: Public OAuth web client identifier used to exchange Google ID tokens with Firebase.

support_email.description: Support contact displayed during activation and in settings.

version.description: Share premium En vivo and Picture-in-Picture gates across Android and iOS.
